items.title: Tim Cook built Apple’s $32M-an-hour growth machine: Can John Ternus keep it going?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Tech Editor Dan Howley look back at Tim Cook’s tenure as Apple (AAPL) CEO, a period that saw the company generate roughly $32 million in growth per hour. They also look ahead to incoming CEO John Ternus and what it will take to keep Apple’s growth engine firing.

items.title: AMD Lost SpaceX to Nvidia. Is Its AI Challenge Already Falling Apart?
items.summary: SpaceX just handed NVIDIA a high-profile win by locking in 20% of its next platform, leaving AMD without a flagship logo at the worst possible moment. The real question is whether this signals a crack in Lisa Su's ambitions or just the cost of competing in a market built on scarcity and politics.

items.title: QQQ Cut Its Fee After 26 Years. On $250,000, the VGT ETF Still Saves You $225 Every Year

items.title: Meta (META) Quietly Became A Major AI Customer While Building Its Own API Business
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) has become one of Microsoft's largest AI customers, according to recent internal discussions. The company is exploring a new API business that could let external developers tap Meta's own AI infrastructure. The plan aims to reduce Meta's reliance on outside vendors while creating a potential revenue stream from its internal compute stack. The shift highlights how large tech groups are rethinking AI infrastructure partnerships and in house capacity as of August...
